t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2010, a temporary building that no longer stands. It was designed by the French architect Jean Nouvel. Nouvel studied at the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris and helped found France's first labour union for architects. His career has brought him the Aga Khan Award for Architecture, the Wolf Prize in Arts in 2005 and the Pritzker Prize in 2008. Museums and architectural centres have mounted retrospectives of his work, so this pavilion belongs to the story of a major figure in modern architecture.
